entries.proposition: Continuous video-EEG of 20 to 24 hours was recorded in 8 controls (four females, four males) and 8 knockouts (six females, two males).
entries.snippet: we implanted epidural electrodes in control (n = 8; four females and four males) and cKO (n = 8; six females and two males) mice and conducted continuous video‐EEG recordings sessions lasting 20–24 h for each animal.
entries.anchor: Results / Slc35a2 cKO mice have more severe induced seizures and exhibit spontaneous seizures

entries.proposition: Spontaneous seizures were captured in six of eight knockouts (two male, four female) and in no control.
entries.snippet: we captured spontaneous seizures in six of eight cKO mice (two male and four female mice). In control female and male mice, we did not observe EEG seizures.
entries.anchor: Results / Slc35a2 cKO mice have more severe induced seizures and exhibit spontaneous seizures

entries.proposition: PTZ was given at 45 mg/kg intraperitoneally to adult mice.
entries.snippet: pentylenetetrazole (PTZ), a γ‐aminobutyric acid antagonist, via intraperitoneal injection at a dose of 45 mg/kg body weight

entries.proposition: The text prints F 1, 17 = 13 with p = .0022 for the female knockout comparison.
entries.snippet: whereas four of five cKO mice developed severe tonic–clonic seizures with respiratory arrest (Racine = 7; two‐way ANOVA, F 1, 17 = 13, p = .0022; Figure 3A)

entries.proposition: The text prints the same F 1, 17 = 13 with p < .0001 for the male knockout comparison.
entries.snippet: male cKO mice developed significant severe tonic–clonic seizures (Racine = 5–7) with tonic extension and respiratory arrest (two‐way ANOVA, F 1, 17 = 13, p < .0001; Figure 3A)

entries.proposition: The text prints the same F 1, 17 = 13 with p = .0003 for the female against male control comparison.
entries.snippet: PTZ‐induced seizure response was significantly different between female and male control (two‐way ANOVA, F 1, 17 = 13, p = .0003; Figure 3A)

entries.proposition: Eighty percent of knockouts suffered severe tonic-clonic seizures followed by death from respiratory arrest.
entries.snippet: Of female and male cohorts, 80% of cKO mice suffered from severe tonic–clonic seizures followed by death caused by respiratory arrest.

entries.proposition: CNPase staining in knockouts showed patches of hypomyelination in cortex, corpus callosum, caudate/putamen, anterior commissure and lateral septum.
entries.snippet: CNPase protein expression in cKO mice revealed patches of hypomyelination through the cortical layers, corpus callosum, caudate/putamen, anterior commissure, and lateral septal region

entries.proposition: Myelin was quantified as percent area covered by CNPase staining by automated thresholding in ImageJ, with n = 3 per timepoint per sex.
entries.snippet: Semiquantitative analysis using automated thresholding to determine area covered by stain was performed in ImageJ and averaged across all brain sections per animal.

entries.proposition: The legend of the myelin figure gives n = 3 per timepoint per sex for control and knockout mice.
entries.snippet: abundant and widespread at postnatal day (P) 15, P21, and P60 in littermate control mice (n = 3 per timepoint per sex)

entries.proposition: Fewer oligodendrocytes were seen in the medial and lateral corpus callosum and gray-white junction of knockouts.
entries.snippet: We observed fewer oligodendrocytes in the medial/lateral corpus callosum and the gray–white matter junction of male and female cKO mice compared to littermate controls

entries.proposition: Slc35a2 protein was not significantly reduced in female knockouts, which the authors attribute to X-linked inactivation.
entries.snippet: We did not see a significant reduction in the female cKO mice, which may be explained by the X‐linked inactivation of the Slc35a2 gene

entries.proposition: The authors claim that spontaneous seizures with an intact neuronal compartment show oligodendrocyte abnormalities alone are sufficient to lower the threshold for epileptogenesis.
entries.snippet: spontaneous electroclinical seizures were detected, providing direct evidence that oligodendrocyte abnormalities alone are sufficient to lower the threshold for epileptogenesis
